title: Netflix Video Streaming: Complete Design
description: Design netflix video streaming with OOP principles, class diagrams, and scalable C# implementations.

data.text: Design a netflix video streaming using object-oriented principles. Focus on clean class design, proper encapsulation, and extensible architecture.

data.caption: Interaction flow for Netflix Video Streaming. Shows how components collaborate to fulfill a user request.
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as NetflixVideoStreamingService
    participant US as User
    participant CO as Content
    participant ST as Stream
    participant PL as Playlist

    C->>S: Request
    S->>CO: Stream()
    CO-->>S: Result
    S->>ST: Pause()
    ST-->>S: Result
    S->>PL: Resume()
    PL-->>S: Result
    S->>PL: AddToPlaylist()
    PL-->>S: Result
    S-->>C: Response

data.text: Extend the design with patterns like Strategy, Observer, and Factory to handle complexity and ensure the netflix video streaming scales gracefully.

data.title: netflix-streaming.Advanced.cs — Processor Pipeline
Design Principles Applied
data.text: Use composition over inheritance. Keep entities simple. Use interfaces to decouple services from implementations. Apply CQRS when read and write patterns diverge.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Encapsulate state inside entities; expose behavior, not data
Strategy and Command patterns make behavior pluggable
Dependency injection keeps classes loosely coupled
data.takeaway: Netflix Video Streaming demonstrates how clean OOP design leads to maintainable, testable code that can evolve with requirements.
